name: Linear Track Base
description: You can build the track using the Linear Track Extension component. This base component provides 3 blocks that can be built on. A pair of on/off signals allow you to control the up and down motion of the slider, and a numerical output lets you measure the slider's offset from its starting position. Multiple slider bases can run along the same track. The up/down speed can be configured by selecting this component with the select tool.
shortDescription: A slider that moves along a modular linear track.

logicNodes.label: Down
logicNodes.description: Moves the slider in the track's down direction (indicated by the hollow arrow).

logicNodes.label: Up
logicNodes.description: Moves the slider in the track's up direction (indicated by the filled arrow).

logicNodes.label: Slider Position
logicNodes.description: The measured offset of the slider from its starting position.

logicNodes.label: RPS
logicNodes.description: Power connection for transfering mechanical energy.
